06418edab579: Does the AI Agent replace our travel advisors?
083b57c36592: Absolutely not. The AI Agent is designed as a high-performance assistant that frees your team from repetitive tasks. It handles first contact 24/7, precisely qualifies needs (budget, dates, family composition, special wishes) and lays the groundwork. As soon as the project takes shape, a human advisor takes over with everything they need to close the sale and add their human expertise.
231b499eb150: What are the AI Agent's main day-to-day tasks?
9749c86b6833: The AI Agent acts as a true digital teammate for your agency:
d5534795a7d6:
- Instant availability: answering travelers day and night in under a minute.
- Rigorous qualification: asking the right questions so no critical trip detail is missed.
- Dynamic search: querying your catalogs and price offers in real time.
- Follow-up: intelligently following up with leads to maximize your quote conversion rate.
5d621372bc71: What is an AI agent for travel agencies?
914613fb21e0: An AI agent for travel agencies is a conversational assistant specialized in tourism, able to chat with travelers, understand their plans and take action within the agency's tools. The Travelife AI Agent is connected to the agency's offers and to Travelife SmartCRM: it greets the customer on WhatsApp or the website, qualifies the request (destination, dates, number of travelers, budget), searches available products, presents proposals with photos and prices, then passes a complete file to an advisor. The agency keeps selling even after closing time.
31f33e824e51: What is the difference between a traditional chatbot and the Travelife AI Agent?
4685152bc91a: A traditional chatbot follows fixed scripts and returns generic answers. The Travelife AI Agent understands natural language, including voice messages, and takes action: it actually queries your Travelife B2C catalog, your hotel rate sheets and your partner APIs to offer up-to-date availability and prices. It presents the payment options set by the agency, attaches proofs of payment to the booking file and syncs everything to Travelife SmartCRM. It is an AI Agent built into your TravelTech, not a generic chatbot added to your website.
